title: Echoes of the Dao
description: Late-game opportunities and tests that explore transcendence and legacy.

events.title: The Whispering Ridge
events.description: You find a ridge where the Dao seems to hum. An old inscription promises insight at a price.

events.title: Hidden Mnemonic
events.description: The inscription opens a mnemonic that grants comprehension but tests your resolve.

events.title: Traveler's Gift
events.description: A wandering immortal offers a relic in exchange for a favor: teach a child the basics of cultivation.
